name: orion-lib Pack and Publish

taskMap.github: no step: the .NET SDK on the runner ships NuGet
run steps: restore, build, test, pack over the project globs (find/xargs)
run: dotnet nuget push to the feed URL variable with the API key secret
taskMap.note: the external feed credential orion-nuget-feed is assumed to be an API key

unsupported.reason: A run cannot rename itself with the branch name on GitHub
unsupported.suggestion: put the branch in the package version suffix or the artifact name if it is needed

acceptedWarnings.why: The source gives these jobs no environment and keeps the credentials at repository level (Azure variable groups are not environment-scoped). Scoping them to a GitHub environment is a hardening choice for the reviewer; it would add approvals and deployment records the source does not have.

notes: packageVersion is 1.4.<run number>, not 1.4.<Build.BuildId>: GitHub has no build id with the same meaning, so version numbers will differ from Azure's.
The unused 'prerelease' variable is not converted.
